title: SAF Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents intending to take up citizenship. Good GCE 'A' Level or IB results, Polytechnic Diploma (with Merit). Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records. Must qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School.
funding_details: Full tuition fees, monthly allowance, overseas exposure programmes, mentorship. Covers undergraduate studies at local or overseas universities.
duration: Duration of undergraduate studies plus bond period

title: MHA Civilian Scholarship
eligibility_summary: All-rounded individuals passionate about strengthening Singapore's safety and security. Singapore citizens. Can choose from Generalist or Specialist roles (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology).
funding_details: Full tuition fees, living allowance, learning and development opportunities. Three tiers available: Singapore Government Scholarship (SGS), Local Merit Scholarship (LMS), Home Team Local Study Award (HTLSA).

title: Singapore Police Force Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) - Singapore Police Force
eligibility_summary: Outstanding leadership qualities, impeccable integrity, strong interest in policing work. Singapore citizens. Open to male and female applicants.
funding_details: Full undergraduate sponsorship at local or overseas universities, with allowances and development opportunities.

title: PSC Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities and potential. Well-rounded individuals with good academic and non-academic records. Pre-university or mid-term applicants (up to penultimate year).
funding_details: Full tuition fees, monthly allowance, overseas exposure, developmental programmes. Covers local or overseas undergraduate studies.

title: PSC Master's Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Final year undergraduate students or fresh graduates with no more than 3 years working experience. Must start Master's in immediate academic year following offer.
funding_details: Full tuition fees, monthly allowance, developmental programmes. Two tracks: PSC Master's Scholarship and PSC Master's Scholarship (Sustainability).

title: Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens only. Track record of leadership and achievement. Potential to excel in chosen field. No course restrictions.
funding_details: Full tuition fees + annual allowance of S$50,000 (up to 2 years for Master's, up to 5 years for PhD). Up to S$135,000 annually depending on course and institution.
duration: Up to 2 years (Master's) or up to 5 years (PhD)

title: MOE Teaching Scholarship (Full-Term)
application_deadline: 19 March 2027 (for A-Level applicants); February 2027 (Polytechnic); October 2026 (IB); December 2026 (NUS High School)
application_opening_date: September 2026 (PSC); February 2027 (Polytechnic); October 2026 (IB); December 2026 (NUS High School)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or PRs willing to take up citizenship. Strong passion for education service, leadership qualities. Various qualification-specific windows.
funding_details: Full tuition fees, allowances, developmental opportunities for teaching career in Singapore.

title: Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Good GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB Diploma or NUS High School Diploma. Good CCA records and leadership achievements. Passion to contribute to Singapore's strategic sectors. Three schemes: Full-Term, Mid-Term (Local), Mid-Term (Overseas).
funding_details: Full tuition fees, monthly allowance, overseas exposure. Bond required to work with sponsoring organisation after graduation.

title: SINGA - Singapore International Graduate Award
provider: A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research)
eligibility_summary: International graduates (all nationalities except Singapore citizens and PRs). Excellent academic results, strong research portfolio, proficiency in English.
funding_details: Full PhD tuition fee coverage, monthly stipend S$2,700 (S$3,200 after qualifying exam), one-time settling-in allowance S$1,000, airfare grant up to S$1,500, conference funding.

title: A*STAR International Fellowship (AIF)
provider: A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or Singapore PRs. Completed PhD within last 4 years. No existing institutional bonds. Must have secured postdoctoral position at leading overseas institution. Two tracks: Research and Innovation.
funding_details: Up to 2 years overseas postdoctoral training. Monthly overseas living allowance, monthly sustenance allowance with CPF, annual return airfare, settling-in and computer allowances, conference allowance, annual personal insurance.

title: National Science Scholarship (PhD)
provider: A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or other nationals intending to take up Singapore citizenship. Good class of Honours degree. Must have applied for PhD at top overseas institution. 1-year research attachment at A*STAR required before PhD.
funding_details: Up to 4 years funding. Full tuition, sustenance allowance, airfare, book/conference allowances. Bond: 4 years (PhD) or 5 years (BS-PhD).
duration: Up to 4 years (PhD); up to 8 years (BS-PhD)

title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
provider: A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research)
eligibility_summary: Currently enrolled in Singapore autonomous university. Completed at least 1 semester. On track to excellent academic standing. Non-Singaporeans must have SPR or citizenship. Four tracks: STEM, Semiconductor, Quantum, Computing.
funding_details: Full tuition coverage up to 4 years, monthly stipend, book/computer/conference/thesis allowances, up to 12 months overseas research attachment support.

title: NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (incl. Global Merit, Merit, AI Talent, Sports, Performing & Visual Arts)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records, outstanding academic results (GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent).
funding_details: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees, living allowance (varies by scholarship type), computer allowance, travel grants, overseas exchange opportunities. NUS Global Merit: highest tier with most comprehensive benefits.

title: NUS Research Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Outstanding graduate students. At least Second Class Honours (Upper division) or equivalent. Must be offered admission to full-time graduate research programme. Must be eligible for MOE subsidy.
funding_details: Full tuition fee waiver. Monthly stipend: SC S$3,800, SPR S$3,400, International S$3,000 (PhD); additional S$500/month after passing PhD Qualifying Examination.
duration: Up to 2 years (Master's); up to 4 years (PhD)

title: Nanyang Global Scholarship
application_deadline: Same as admission deadline (varies by qualification)
eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Outstanding academic achievements, excellent CCA records, strong leadership qualities. Full-time undergraduate programme at NTU.
funding_details: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant), living allowance S$6,500/year, accommodation allowance up to S$2,000/year, travel grant up to S$8,000, computer allowance S$2,000 (one-off). Enrolment in NTU Honours College.

title: Nanyang Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Outstanding freshmen with strong academic results, good CCA records, good leadership qualities. Full-time undergraduate programme at NTU.
funding_details: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees, living allowance S$5,000/year, travel grant S$4,000 (one-off). No bond apart from MOE Tuition Grant bond for PRs/international students.

title: NTU President Award
eligibility_summary: Students with exceptional leadership qualities, excellent co-curricular records, outstanding academic performance.
funding_details: Generous financial benefits plus exclusive non-financial benefits and development opportunities.

title: SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities. Applying for full-time undergraduate degree at SMU.
funding_details: Waiver of annual subsidized tuition fees (up to 4 years), S$14,000 GLOW grant for overseas programmes, S$5,000 annual living allowance, S$1,800 computer allowance, S$9,000 Enhanced Flexibility Grant, up to S$40,000 for Master's programme. Bond-free.

title: SMU Merit Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Academic excellence, outstanding leadership qualities, commitment to community.
funding_details: Full or partial tuition fee waiver, growth opportunities allowance, overseas exposure.

title: Lee Kong Chian Scholars' Programme (LKCSP)
eligibility_summary: High-calibre Singapore citizens. Academic excellence, leadership potential, entrepreneurial development interest.
funding_details: Full four-year tuition fee waiver, one-off notebook grant, sponsorship for international exchange, overseas study mission, international community service project.

title: Temasek Undergraduate Overseas Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Local polytechnic graduates or graduating polytechnic students. Accepted or planning to enroll in STEM undergraduate course at overseas university (excluding Medicine and Dentistry). Gross Monthly Household Income <= S$15,000.
funding_details: Full cost of studies including course fees, allowance, accommodation and flights where needed. Structured internships, job rotations, networking and mentorship.
duration: Duration of undergraduate studies (capped at 4 years) + 3-year bond

title: Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Polytechnic graduates enrolling in STEM programmes at Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT).
funding_details: Full tuition fees and allowances for STEM studies at SIT.

title: SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
provider: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding GCE 'A' Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or equivalent. Passion for technology and design.
funding_details: Full coverage of subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant) for normal duration (up to 4 years). No bond.

title: SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship
provider: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities, desire to make impact on society.
funding_details: Full tuition coverage and additional benefits for high-performing students.

title: SUSS Scholarship (Part-time Undergraduate)
eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents. Outstanding academic results, strong language skills, impressive CCA track record, leadership qualities, community service involvement.
funding_details: Tuition fee coverage for minimum period required to complete programme. Monthly stipend for full-time students.

title: SUSS Research Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Applicants seeking admission to PhD or Master of Applied Research in Social Sciences. At least 2nd Upper Class Honours Degree. Research aligned with SUSS focus areas.
funding_details: Tuition fees, miscellaneous fees, monthly stipend (S$3,000 for full-time students). Government-subsidised tuition fees available.
duration: Up to 4 years (PhD); up to 2 years (Master's)

title: SUSS PhD Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Applicants to full-time PhD programmes (PhD, PhD (Gerontology), PhD (Engineering)). At least 2nd Upper Class Honours Degree.
funding_details: Tuition fees, miscellaneous fees, monthly stipend. Government-subsidised tuition fees for eligible Singapore Citizens and PRs.

title: NTU Undergraduate Scholarships (Merit-based, Need-based, Talent-based)
application_deadline: Same as admission deadline (varies by qualification)
eligibility_summary: Varies by scholarship. Generally: outstanding academic results, CCA records, leadership qualities, talent achievements, or financial need. Open to Singapore citizens, PRs, and international students depending on scholarship.
funding_details: Full or partial tuition coverage, living allowances, book/travel/computer allowances. Over 100 scholarships available including Nanyang Scholarship, Nanyang Merit Scholarship, Dean's Award, and donor-sponsored awards.

title: NTU Short Term Scholarships
eligibility_summary: Current undergraduates or freshmen on subsidised tuition fees who have performed well academically and meet donor criteria.
funding_details: Awards ranging from S$3,000 to S$16,000 per academic year. Freshmen apply two days after matriculation.
